method: Numerical integration of model station cross-sections at EVEN KEEL; all exterior hull surfaces assumed to exclude water. Mass equivalent includes the entire craft and load, NOT payload.
all_up_weight_inputs: Hull structure, T-top, glass, motor, rigging, fuel, batteries, people, tackle, ice and livewell water must all be included.
target_definition: Less than 12 inches STATIC HULL draft at an agreed load; engine raised. Does not establish the lowest appendage or safe running/idle/acceleration depth.

references.name: Shallow Sport 24 Mod V: 10.5 in at rest, different tunnel hull

limits: No actual structure/equipment mass budget exists.
Even-keel section areas do not solve trim; the waterline and CG must be assessed together.
Motor, propeller, trim tabs, strakes, transducers and trolling motor clearance assessed separately.
Changing deadrise has NOT been tested for ride, stability, handling or strength.
No displacement result here is a load rating or engineering qualification.
